info.title: urlet JSON API
info.description: JSON API of urlet, a self-hosted URL shortener. Everything except the health probes, the public shortener and the link unlock lives under `/api/v1` and answers `application/json; charset=utf-8`. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC and JSON responses are always English, whatever interface language the visitor selected. Authenticate with the `urlet_session` cookie or with `Authorization: Bearer ur_...`.

post.description: Creates the account and signs it in, setting the session cookie. In `invite` registration mode an invite code is mandatory; in `open` mode it is optional but validated when supplied, and its group wins over the default group. Bot verification is only enforced when it is enabled for registration.

201.description: Account created and signed in; the response also sets a session cookie.

post.description: Verifies the credentials and sets the `urlet_session` cookie. Wrong credentials return a fixed `401` message that does not reveal whether the account exists; a suspended account returns `403`. Repeated failures lock the account and answer `429`.

200.description: Signed in; the response also sets a session cookie.

post.description: Revokes the current session and clears the session cookie. The call may also be made anonymously, in which case only the cookie is cleared.

204.description: Session revoked and the session cookie cleared.

get.description: Returns the account, the group it belongs to (or `null`) and the effective limits. The `limits` object is already resolved: a group overrides a site-wide value only when its own value is not `NULL`, and `0` means unlimited.

200.description: The current account and the rules that apply to it.

patch.description: Updates the profile of the authenticated account. An omitted field, `null` or an empty string clears the display name.

post.description: Changes the password of the authenticated account. On success every other session is revoked and all API tokens of the account are revoked; the current session survives.

204.description: Password changed; other sessions and all API tokens were revoked.

get.summary: List the sessions of the account
get.description: Lists every session of the account, newest first. Sessions slide: activity pushes `expires_at` forward and re-issues the cookie, so continuous use never expires.

delete.description: Revokes one session of the authenticated account. A session that belongs to somebody else is reported as `404`, exactly as a missing one.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the session to revoke.

get.description: Lists the short links of the authenticated account, newest first, with the documented filters applied. `per_page` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search slug, title and target URL; `%` and `_` are treated literally.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only return links that carry this tag name.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return links in this stored status.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Each field also accepts its explicit direction suffix (`clicks_desc`, `slug_asc`, `updated_desc`, `expires_asc`). Any other value, including `created_at`, falls back to newest first.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

post.description: Creates a short link. `target_url` is required and only `http`/`https` are accepted. A supplied `domain` must be active and allowed by the group policy; `slug` is generated when omitted and must be unique on the selected domain. `captcha_token` is only read for a session-cookie call when bot verification is enabled for link creation; a Bearer token call ignores it.

get.description: Returns one short link of the authenticated account. A link that belongs to somebody else is reported as `404`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

patch.description: Partial update: a field that is absent stays unchanged, while an explicit `null` clears it. An empty object returns `400`. Moving a link to another active domain must satisfy the group policy and re-checks the slug there; keeping a link on its current domain is always allowed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

delete.description: Soft delete. The slug is retained and never released, so an old link cannot be hijacked, and the analytics data is kept.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

get.summary: Get the statistics of a short link
get.description: Returns the summary, the daily trend and the referrer, device, browser and operating system breakdowns of one link. `days` is clamped to 1-365 (default 30) and the daily series is padded with the days that had no clicks.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Length of the reporting window in days, from 1 to 365.

get.summary: List the clicks of a short link
get.description: Returns a paginated click log, newest first. The log deliberately carries no IP addresses and no visitor hashes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

200.description: A page of the click log.

get.summary: Get the saved preview of a short link
get.description: Returns the custom SNS preview metadata of one link. An unconfigured preview returns null fields and false flags. Another owner's link is reported as `404`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

patch.summary: Update the preview of a short link
patch.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged; `null` or a blank string clears the field. Setting or clearing `image_url` replaces or removes any uploaded image. Title and description are limited to 200 and 1000 characters, and an image URL must be absolute HTTPS.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

200.description: The preview metadata after the update.

delete.summary: Delete the preview of a short link
delete.description: Clears all custom preview text and removes the uploaded image bytes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

post.summary: Upload the preview image of a short link
post.description: Replaces the preview image while preserving the text. Uploads are PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, at most 2 MiB and 4096 x 4096 pixels; the MIME type is detected from the validated bytes. Uploads are refused with `403` while the instance disables them and share a per-account rate budget.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

image.description: Image file to store as the preview image.

200.description: The preview metadata with the new image.

get.description: Lists the active domains available for new links, already filtered by the group policy of the caller. `is_default` marks the effective group default.

get.summary: List the invite codes of the account
get.description: Returns the caller's own codes, newest first, including the displayable code and its registration link, plus the effective quota. Member issuance is throttled to 20 codes per hour per account.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

200.description: The invite codes of the account and its quota.

post.description: Issues a code for the group of the caller. The group must enable `allow_invites` and its calendar quota applies; `max_uses` must be between 1 and 10. Exceeding the hourly burst limit returns `429`.

delete.description: Revokes one of the caller's own codes. Another member's code is reported as `404`. Revoking a code that nobody redeemed returns its quota slot; a redeemed code keeps it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the invite code.

get.description: Lists every tag of the authenticated account; the list is not paginated.

delete.description: Deletes a tag. It only unlinks the tag from short links; the links themselves are untouched.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the tag.

post.summary: Create a short link without an account
post.description: The JSON form of the public shortener, for scripts. No credential is required when `public_create_access` is `guest`; a session cookie or a Bearer token may be supplied instead, and the link is then owned by that account. Anonymous requests must match the enabled guest destination allowlist. The link id is deliberately not returned.

get.summary: Get the public metadata of a short link
get.description: Returns public metadata without the target URL. Without `domain` the default domain is used, which keeps callers that predate multi-domain working for links on the default domain.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Slug of the short link.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Hostname of the domain the link lives on; omitted uses the default domain.

get.description: Lists every API token of the account; the list is not paginated.

200.description: The API tokens of the account.

post.description: Creates a personal API token and returns its plaintext value this one time only. Creation is refused with `403` when the group disables API tokens or the effective `max_api_tokens` is exhausted; only usable tokens count against the quota.

201.description: Token created; the plaintext value is returned only in this response.

delete.description: Revokes one token of the account, which frees its quota slot immediately. Another account's token is reported as `404`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the API token.

get.description: Lists every domain of the instance with its link count, status, source and the administrative flags that say which actions are currently allowed.

post.description: Adds a domain, created with the status `pending`. A duplicate hostname is a `409` conflict.

patch.description: Activates, disables or promotes a domain. A domain cannot be disabled and made the default in one request, and the default marker cannot be cleared through this call.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the domain.

delete.description: Deletes a domain. Only a `ui` domain that has no links and is not the default can be deleted; anything else is a `409` conflict.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the domain.

get.description: Lists the accounts of the instance with their link count, group id and group name. `per_page` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search email and display name.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only return accounts with this role.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return accounts with this status.

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Only return accounts that belong to this group.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

patch.description: Changes the role, status, display name or group of an account; `group_id: null` makes the account ungrouped. An administrator cannot change their own role or status, and the instance always keeps at least one active administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the account.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the account and all of its short links. An administrator cannot delete themselves, and the instance always keeps at least one active administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the account.

204.description: Account and its short links soft-deleted.

post.summary: Reset the password of a user
post.description: Sets a new password for an account and revokes every session of that account. The new password must satisfy the instance password policy.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the account.

204.description: Password reset; every session of the account was revoked.

get.description: Lists every short link on the instance with the documented filters. `per_page` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search slug, title and target URL.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return links in this stored status.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Only return links owned by this account.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Each field also accepts its explicit direction suffix (`clicks_desc`, `slug_asc`, `updated_desc`, `expires_asc`). Any other value, including `created_at`, falls back to newest first.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

patch.description: Changes the stored status or the redirect status code of any short link.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

delete.description: Soft-deletes any short link on the instance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the short link.

get.description: Lists every invite code of the instance with its code, link, prefix and group. `code` and `link` are `null` for legacy or secret-rotated rows, and `link` is also `null` for revoked, exhausted or expired codes.

200.description: Every invite code of the instance.

post.description: Issues a code, optionally pinned to a group and with an expiry. A code without `group_id` consumes the site-wide quota; exceeding the per-period quota returns `403`.

delete.description: Revokes any invite code. An unused code returns its quota slot; a redeemed code keeps it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the invite code.

get.description: Lists the user groups with their member counts and live invite counters. `per_page` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

200.description: A page of groups; `items` are `GroupDto` objects.

post.description: Creates a group. `name` is required; omitted quotas inherit the site-wide setting, omitted toggles keep their create defaults, `default_domain_id` must reference an active domain and `domain_ids` must reference existing domains.

put.description: Replaces the mutable fields of a group. `name` is required; other omitted fields keep their current value, quotas set to `null` inherit the site quota, `description: null` clears it, `domain_ids: null` or `[]` clears the allowlist and `is_default: true` moves the single default marker.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the group.

delete.description: Moves the members to `reassign_to` and deletes the group. The default group cannot be deleted, and a missing or invalid target is a `409` conflict; move the marker with `PUT` first.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric id of the group.

parameters.name: reassign_to
parameters.description: Id of the group that receives the members of the deleted group.

204.description: Group deleted after its members were moved.

get.description: Returns every theme, including administrator uploads, plus who may switch themes (`all` or `admin`).

200.description: The theme catalogue and the switching policy.

put.description: Replaces the enabled themes, the default theme or the switching policy. Omitted fields keep their value; at least one enabled theme and an enabled default are required, and `enabled` and `default` may name `custom-...` uploads.

200.description: The theme catalogue after the update.

get.description: Returns the current settings as a flat string map, including `theme_switching` and the bot verification keys. The captcha secret key is write-only and never returned in plaintext.

schema.description: Setting key/value pairs; every value is a string.

put.description: Writes the supplied setting keys and returns the whole resulting map. An invalid batch returns `422` and changes neither the database nor the settings cache; an empty captcha secret key keeps the stored value.

schema.description: Setting key/value pairs to write; every value is a string.
Setting key/value pairs; every value is a string.

get.description: Returns the audit log with the documented filters; the `metadata` column is parsed into JSON. `per_page` defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only return entries with this audit action code.

parameters.name: target_type
parameters.description: Only return entries that target this object type.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Only return entries performed by this account id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

200.description: A page of audit entries; `items` are `AuditDto` objects.

get.description: Returns the user, short link and click totals, the database size, the version and the uptime of the instance.

200.description: Instance totals used by the admin dashboard.

admins.description: Number of accounts with the `admin` role.

total_clicks.description: All recorded clicks, including automated traffic.

expired_links.description: Number of links that expired or reached their click limit.

active_invites.description: Number of invite codes that can still be redeemed.

active_tokens.description: Number of API tokens that can still authenticate.

database_bytes.description: Size of the SQLite database in bytes, or `null` when it is unknown.

registration_mode.description: Effective registration mode of the instance.

get.description: Answers the health of the instance for docker health checks and uptime probes. When the database cannot be queried the response is `503` with `status: degraded`.

200.description: The instance and its database are healthy.

503.description: The database could not be queried; `status` is `degraded`.

get.description: An alias of `GET /health` with the same response and status codes.

200.description: The instance and its database are healthy.

503.description: The database could not be queried; `status` is `degraded`.

post.description: Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. A JSON request that succeeds answers `200` with the next path and sets the unlock cookie; a form request is answered with `303` to `/{slug}`. The destination is never disclosed before the password is accepted, and repeated failures are rate limited.

servers.description: The origin of the short link. Use the origin the link was created on, as returned by `GET /api/v1/domains`; a link on an extra short-link domain is unlocked there, not on the canonical API host.

origin.description: The short link's origin, including scheme.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Slug of the password-protected short link.

200.description: Password accepted; the unlock cookie is set in this response.

303.description: The form request succeeded; the response redirects to `/{slug}` and sets the unlock cookie.

Location.description: Same-site path of the unlocked link.

UserDto.description: Public representation of a user. Never contains a password hash.

display_name.description: Display name, or `null` when the account has none.

status.description: Account status. A `suspended` account cannot sign in.

group_id.description: Id of the user group that supplies the account quotas, or `null` when ungrouped.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the account was created.

last_login_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful sign-in, or `null` if never.

LimitsDto.description: Effective quotas and feature toggles of the current user. The object is already resolved: a group overrides a site-wide value only when its own value is not `NULL`, and a quota of `0` means unlimited.

max_urls.description: Maximum number of short links the account may own; `0` means unlimited.

max_api_tokens.description: Maximum number of usable API tokens the account may hold; `0` means unlimited.

allow_custom_slug.description: Whether the account may submit its own `slug` when creating a link.

allow_password.description: Whether the account may password-protect a link.

allow_expiry.description: Whether the account may set `expires_at` on a link.

allow_max_clicks.description: Whether the account may set `max_clicks` on a link.

allow_tags.description: Whether the account may attach tags to a link.

allow_api_tokens.description: Whether the account may create API tokens at all.

allow_domain_selection.description: Whether the account may pick a domain other than the effective default. When `false`, only `default_domain` is accepted for new links or moves.

redirect_mode_policy.description: Which redirect modes the account may use for new links. `choice` allows both `direct` and `splash`; the policy never rewrites existing links. An ungrouped account gets `choice`.

default_domain.description: Effective default domain hostname for new links, falling back to the site default when the group default is missing or disabled.

allowed_domains.description: Effective selection list of active domain hostnames the account may use.

MeDto.description: `GET /api/v1/auth/me`: the user plus the rules that apply to them.

group.description: Group the account belongs to, or `null` for an ungrouped account.

user_agent.description: User agent recorded when the session was created, or `null` when the client sent none.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the session was created.

last_seen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent activity, written at most once per minute.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the session expires. Sessions slide: activity pushes this forward and re-issues the cookie, so continuous use never expires.

current.description: Whether this is the session that authenticated the request.

revoked.description: Whether the session has been revoked and can no longer authenticate.

Page.description: Standard pagination envelope. Concrete page schemas `allOf`-extend this one and narrow `items` to a specific DTO; language files reference the concrete schema.

per_page.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

total.description: Total number of rows across every page.

total_pages.description: Total number of pages; never less than 1, even when `total` is 0.

UrlDto.description: Public representation of a short link.

domain.description: Hostname of the domain the link lives on. The slug namespace is per domain.

slug.description: Short code of the link; a generated 7-character base62 slug unless it was custom.

short_url.description: Ready-to-share short URL, built from the request scheme and the link domain.

title.description: Optional human-readable title, or `null` when unset.

notes.description: Private notes of the owner, or `null` when unset. Never shown publicly.

tags.description: Tag names attached to the link.

has_password.description: Whether the link is password protected. The password itself is never returned.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry timestamp, or `null` when the link never expires.

expires_in.description: Humanized remaining time until `expires_at` (for example `in 52 months`), or `null`.

max_clicks.description: Click budget of the link, or `null` when it has none. The value is at least 1.

click_count.description: Total number of recorded clicks, including automated traffic.

unique_click_count.description: Number of clicks classified as unique visitors.

redirect_type.description: HTTP status code used for the redirect.

splash_delay_seconds.description: Countdown of the splash page, 1-60 (default 5). Stored even while the link is direct.

splash_title.description: Custom splash headline (at most 120 characters), or `null` for the built-in copy.

splash_message.description: Custom splash message (at most 500 characters), or `null` for the built-in copy.

status.description: Stored link status. `disabled` stops redirects without deleting the link.

is_expired.description: `true` when the link no longer redirects because it expired or reached its click limit.

state.description: Derived lifecycle state, combining `status`, the expiry and the click budget.

is_custom_slug.description: Whether the slug was supplied by the caller instead of generated.

last_clicked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent click, or `null` if never clicked.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the link was created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last modification.

color.description: Optional display colour of the tag, or `null` when unset.

url_count.description: Number of short links that carry this tag.

StatsSummaryDto.description: Summary numbers for one link or one account.

total_clicks.description: All recorded clicks in the reporting window, including automated traffic.

human_clicks.description: Clicks that were not classified as automated traffic.

first_click_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the first click, or `null` when there were none.

last_click_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent click, or `null` when there were none.

DailyPointDto.description: One day of the trend chart.

clicks.description: All clicks recorded on that day.

unique_clicks.description: Unique-visitor clicks recorded on that day.

bot_clicks.description: Automated clicks recorded on that day.

DimensionDto.description: A label/count pair (referrer, device, browser, OS).

label.description: Value of the dimension, for example a referrer host or a device name.

count.description: Number of clicks that carried this label.

ClickDto.description: One recorded click. Deliberately free of IP addresses and visitor hashes.

clicked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the click.

referrer_host.description: Hostname of the referrer, or `null` for a direct visit.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code derived from the request, or `null` when it is unknown.

device_type.description: Parsed device class, for example `Desktop`, or `null` when it cannot be parsed.

browser.description: Parsed browser name, or `null` when it cannot be parsed.

os.description: Parsed operating system, or `null` when it cannot be parsed.

is_bot.description: Whether the click was classified as automated traffic.

is_unique.description: Whether the click counted as a unique visitor.

password_protected.description: Whether the click happened on a password-protected link.

UrlStatsDto.description: Full statistics payload for one link.

daily.description: One point per day in the window, padded with the days that had no clicks.

SessionList.description: Response of `GET /api/v1/auth/sessions`. The list is not paginated: it always carries every session of the account, so it has no page counters.

items.description: Sessions of the current account, newest first.

RegisterPayload.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/auth/register`. Registering signs the new account in and sets a session cookie.

email.description: Address the account is created with; a duplicate is a `409` conflict.

password.description: Account password; it must satisfy the instance password policy.

invite_code.description: Invite code. Mandatory in `invite` registration mode; in `open` mode it is optional but validated when supplied, and its group wins over the default group.

display_name.description: Optional display name for the new account.

captcha_token.description: Widget token from the web CAPTCHA. Only checked when bot verification is enabled for registration; otherwise the field is ignored.

LoginPayload.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. A success sets the `urlet_session` cookie.

password.description: Account password. Wrong credentials return `401` with a fixed message that does not reveal whether the account exists.

captcha_token.description: Widget token from the web CAPTCHA. Only checked when bot verification is enabled for sign-in; otherwise the field is ignored.

display_name.description: New display name; an omitted field, `null` or an empty string clears it.

ChangePasswordPayload.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/auth/password`. On success every other session is revoked and all API tokens of the account are revoked; the current session survives.

new_password.description: Replacement password; it must satisfy the instance password policy or the request returns `422`.

target_url.description: Destination URL. Required; only `http`/`https` are accepted, and a bare domain without a scheme is given an `https://` prefix.

domain.description: Hostname to create the link on. Omitted uses the effective group default; a hostname that is not an active domain fails with `422`, and one outside the group policy fails with `403`.

slug.description: Requested slug. Omitted generates a 7-character base62 slug; only `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` is allowed, length 1-64, reserved words are rejected, and a slug already used on the selected domain returns `409`.

notes.description: Optional private notes of the owner; never shown publicly.

tags.description: Tag names to attach; an omitted field means no tags.

password.description: Optional link password; the plaintext value is never returned again.

expires_at.description: Expiry timestamp; it must be in the future. Responses use ISO-8601 UTC, and relaxed input forms such as `2030-06-30 12:00` are accepted.

max_clicks.description: Click budget of the link; at least 1.

redirect_type.description: HTTP status code used for the redirect; omitted uses the instance default.

redirect_mode.description: `direct` or `splash`. Omitted takes the group policy's default mode (splash under a splash-only policy, otherwise direct); a mode the group blocks returns `403`.

splash_title.description: Splash headline, at most 120 characters; empty or omitted uses the localised built-in copy.

splash_message.description: Splash message, at most 500 characters; empty or omitted uses the localised built-in copy.

captcha_token.description: Widget token. Only read when the request authenticates with a session cookie and bot verification is enabled for link creation; a Bearer token call ignores it.

UpdatePayload.description: Request body of `PATCH /api/v1/urls/{id}`. Partial update: a field that is absent stays unchanged, while an explicit `null` clears it. An empty object returns `400`.

target_url.description: New destination URL; absent or `null` keeps the current value.

domain.description: New hostname; absent or `null` keeps the current one. Moving a link must satisfy the group policy and re-checks the slug there (`409` on a collision).

slug.description: New slug; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

title.description: New title; absent keeps the current value and `null` clears it.

notes.description: New notes; absent keeps the current value and `null` clears them.

tags.description: Replacement tag list; absent keeps the current tags and `null` clears them.

password.description: New link password; absent keeps the current one and `null` removes it. A non-empty value counts as a new password and is refused while passwords are blocked.

expires_at.description: New expiry timestamp; absent keeps the current one and `null` clears it.

max_clicks.description: New click budget; absent keeps the current one and `null` removes it.

redirect_type.description: New redirect status code; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

redirect_mode.description: New redirect mode; absent or `null` keeps the current one. Switching to a mode the group blocks returns `403`.

splash_delay_seconds.description: New splash countdown, 1-60 seconds; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

splash_title.description: New splash headline; absent keeps the current value and `null` clears it.

splash_message.description: New splash message; absent keeps the current value and `null` clears it.

status.description: Stored link status; absent or `null` keeps the current one. `disabled` stops redirects without deleting the link.

ApiTokenDto.description: Public representation of an API token. The plaintext value is shown only by the create call and never returned here.

name.description: Label given by the owner, at most 60 characters.

prefix.description: Displayable prefix kept in clear for identification.

scopes.description: JSON-encoded scope list stored with the token; new tokens get `["urls:read","urls:write"]`.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the token was created.

last_used_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last authenticated use, or `null` if never used.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry timestamp, or `null` when the token never expires.

revoked.description: Whether the owner revoked the token; revocation frees a quota slot immediately.

active.description: Whether the token can still authenticate (not revoked and not expired).

TokenList.description: Response of `GET /api/v1/tokens`. The list is not paginated: it always carries every token of the account.

items.description: API tokens of the current account, newest first.

name.description: Label for the token, at most 60 characters.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry timestamp; omitted or `null` creates a token that never expires.

CreatedTokenResponse.description: Response of `POST /api/v1/tokens`. The plaintext `token` is shown this one time only and cannot be retrieved again.

token.description: Plaintext token value; store it now, it is never returned again.

MemberInviteDto.description: Public representation of one invite code issued by a member.

prefix.description: Displayable prefix of the code; always present.

code.description: Displayable code, or `null` for codes created before sealed storage or after `URLET_SECRET` changed.

link.description: Registration link prefilled with `code`, or `null` when `code` is `null` or the invite is revoked, exhausted or expired.

note.description: Free-form note of the issuer, or `null` when unset.

group_id.description: Id of the group the code is pinned to, or `null` when it uses the default group.

max_uses.description: Maximum number of redemptions; member codes accept 1-10.

remaining.description: Redemptions left before the code is exhausted.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry timestamp, or `null` when the code never expires.

usable.description: Whether the code can still be redeemed right now.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the code was created.

MemberQuotaDto.description: Effective invite quota of the account, shared with administrator-issued codes.

group_id.description: Id of the group the quota belongs to, or `null` when it falls back to the site quota.

group_name.description: Name of that group, or `null` when there is none.

allowed.description: Whether this account may issue codes right now. `false` means the group does not enable member invites and creation returns `403`.

limit.description: Issuance limit for the period; `0` means unlimited.

period.description: Calendar period of the quota, evaluated in UTC with Monday-based weeks.

used.description: Codes issued in the current period.

remaining.description: Slots left in the current period, or `null` when the limit is unlimited.

MemberInviteList.description: Paginated response of `GET /api/v1/invites`. Unlike the shared `Page` envelope it carries `page`, `per_page` and `total` but no `total_pages`, and it adds the effective member `quota`.

items.description: Invite codes of the current account, newest first.

per_page.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

total.description: Total number of codes across every page.

note.description: Optional free-form note for the new code.

max_uses.description: Maximum number of redemptions, between 1 and 10 for member codes.

CreatedMemberInvite.description: Response of `POST /api/v1/invites`. The code and link are also available from `GET /api/v1/invites`, so they are not lost when the response is dismissed.

code.description: Plaintext code of the new invite.

link.description: Registration link that prefills `code`, or `null` when the new code is already unusable. It mirrors `invite.link`.

DomainChoiceDto.description: One selectable domain returned by `GET /api/v1/domains`, already filtered by the group policy.

is_default.description: Whether this is the effective group default.

PublicUrlDto.description: Public metadata of a link returned by `GET /api/v1/public/urls/{slug}`; the target URL is never disclosed.

domain.description: Hostname of the domain the link lives on.

title.description: Public title of the link, or `null` when it has none.

has_password.description: Whether the link is password protected.

redirect_mode.description: `direct` or `splash`: whether following the link renders an interstitial first. The splash copy itself is not exposed.

is_expired.description: Whether the link no longer redirects because it expired or reached its click limit.

state.description: Derived lifecycle state of the link.

TagList.description: Response of `GET /api/v1/tags`. The list is not paginated: it always carries every tag of the account.

AdminUserDto.description: User row returned by `GET /api/v1/admin/users`: the public user fields are flattened into the same object, which then adds the administrative counters.

link_count.description: Number of short links owned by the account.

group_name.description: Name of the account's group, or `null` when the account is ungrouped.

GroupDto.description: User group returned by the `/api/v1/admin/groups` endpoints. Quotas may be null: `null` inherits the site-wide setting and `0` means unlimited. The request field is `domain_ids`; the response uses the `allowed_*` names.

description.description: Optional group description, or `null` when unset.

max_urls.description: Short links per member; `null` inherits the site-wide quota and `0` means unlimited.

max_api_tokens.description: API tokens per member; `null` inherits the site-wide quota and `0` means unlimited.

max_invites.description: Invite codes per `invite_period`; `null` inherits the site setting and `0` means unlimited.

invite_period.description: Calendar period of the invite quota, evaluated in UTC with Monday-based weeks.

allow_invites.description: Whether the group's members may issue their own invite codes.

invites_used.description: Issued invite codes in the current period.

invites_remaining.description: Slots left in the current period, or `null` when unlimited.

allow_custom_slug.description: Whether members may submit their own `slug`.

allow_password.description: Whether members may password-protect a link.

allow_api_tokens.description: Whether members may create API tokens.

allow_domain_selection.description: Whether members may pick a domain other than the group default.

redirect_mode_policy.description: `direct`, `splash` or `choice` for new links created by members.

default_domain_id.description: Id of the group default domain, or `null` when the site default applies.

default_domain.description: Stored default domain hostname, even when that domain is disabled.

restrict_domains.description: Whether members are limited to the `allowed_domains` allowlist.

allowed_domain_ids.description: Ids of the domains on the group allowlist; empty when unrestricted.

allowed_domains.description: Hostnames of the domains on the group allowlist.

is_default.description: Whether this is the single default group new accounts fall back to.

members.description: Number of accounts in the group.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the group was created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last modification.

InviteDto.description: Invite code as seen by an administrator. `code` and `link` are `null` for legacy or secret-rotated rows, and `link` is also `null` for revoked, exhausted or expired codes.

prefix.description: Displayable prefix of the code; always present.

code.description: Displayable code, or `null` for legacy or secret-rotated rows.

link.description: Registration link prefilled with `code`, or `null` when the code is unusable.

note.description: Free-form note of the issuer, or `null` when unset.

group_id.description: Id of the group the code is pinned to, or `null` for the site-wide quota.

group_name.description: Name of that group, or `null` when there is none.

created_by.description: Id of the administrator who created the code, or `null` when unknown.

remaining.description: Redemptions left before the code is exhausted.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry timestamp, or `null` when the code never expires.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the code was created.

usable.description: Whether the code can still be redeemed right now.

AdminDomainDto.description: Domain row returned by the `/api/v1/admin/domains` endpoints, with link counts, status and source.

status.description: Lifecycle status. A new domain starts as `pending`; only `active` domains resolve.

source.description: How the domain was created (canonical host, `URLET_DOMAINS` seed, or admin UI).

is_default.description: Whether this is the site default domain.

is_verified.description: Whether the hostname has been verified.

link_count.description: Number of short links on the domain.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the domain was created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last modification, or `null` when never updated.

can_activate.description: Whether the administrator may activate the domain now.

can_disable.description: Whether the administrator may disable the domain now.

can_delete.description: Whether the administrator may delete the domain now.

AuditDto.description: One audit log entry returned by `GET /api/v1/admin/audit`.

actor_user_id.description: Id of the acting account, or `null` when the actor is unknown.

actor_role.description: Role of the actor at the time of the action, or `null` when unknown.

action.description: Audit action code, for example `url.created` or `auth.login`.

target_type.description: Type of the affected object, or `null` when the event has no target.

target_id.description: Identifier of the affected object, or `null` when the event has no target.

metadata.description: Parsed JSON metadata of the event, or `null` when the row has none.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the action.

InviteList.description: Response of `GET /api/v1/admin/invites`. The list is not paginated: it always carries every invite code.

CreatedInviteResponse.description: Response of `POST /api/v1/admin/invites`. `link` mirrors `invite.link` and is `null` when the new code is already unusable.

code.description: Plaintext code of the new invite.

link.description: Registration link that prefills `code`, or `null` when the code is unusable.

AdminThemeDto.description: One entry of the theme catalogue returned by `GET /api/v1/admin/themes`.

key.description: Stable theme key, for example `verdant` or a `custom-...` upload key.

description.description: Short description shown in the admin UI.

enabled.description: Whether the theme is currently enabled.

default.description: Whether this is the default theme.

dark_only.description: Whether the theme only offers a dark appearance.

light_only.description: Whether the theme only offers a light appearance.

css_url.description: URL of the stylesheet served for this theme.

themes.description: Every theme in the catalogue, including administrator uploads.

switching.description: Who may switch themes; `admin` restricts the switcher to administrators.

UpdateThemesPayload.description: Request body of `PUT /api/v1/admin/themes`. Omitted fields keep their value; at least one enabled theme and an enabled default are required (`422` otherwise).

enabled.description: Replacement list of enabled theme keys; entries may name `custom-...` uploads.

default.description: Key of the default theme; it must be one of the enabled themes.

CreateDomainPayload.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/admin/domains`. The domain is created as `pending`.

hostname.description: Hostname of the new domain; a duplicate hostname is a `409` conflict.

status.description: New lifecycle status; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

is_default.description: Whether the domain becomes the site default; absent or `null` keeps the current marker.

note.description: Optional free-form note for the new code.

group_id.description: Group the code is pinned to. Omitted or `null` consumes the site-wide quota instead.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry timestamp; omitted or `null` creates a code that never expires.

UpdateUserPayload.description: Request body of `PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id}`. An administrator cannot change their own role or status, and the instance always keeps at least one active administrator.

role.description: New role; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

status.description: New status; absent or `null` keeps the current one. Suspension revokes sessions.

display_name.description: New display name; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

group_id.description: Group assignment: absent keeps the current group, `null` makes the account ungrouped (site defaults apply), and a value assigns that group.

ResetPasswordPayload.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/password`. A success revokes every session of that account.

new_password.description: Replacement password; it must satisfy the instance password policy.

status.description: New stored link status; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

redirect_type.description: New redirect status code; absent or `null` keeps the current one.

GroupPayload.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/admin/groups` and `PUT /api/v1/admin/groups/{id}`. `name` is required; other omitted fields keep their current value, quotas set to `null` inherit the site quota, and `description: null` clears it.

name.description: Group name; required on create and on update.

description.description: Group description; absent keeps the current one and `null` clears it.

max_urls.description: Short links per member; absent keeps the value and `null` inherits the site quota.

max_api_tokens.description: API tokens per member; absent keeps the value and `null` inherits the site quota.

max_invites.description: Invite codes per period; absent keeps the value and `null` inherits the site quota.

invite_period.description: `day`, `week` or `month`; omitted keeps the current period.

allow_invites.description: Whether members may issue their own invite codes; opt-in and `false` on create.

allow_custom_slug.description: Whether members may submit their own `slug`.

allow_password.description: Whether members may password-protect a link.

allow_api_tokens.description: Whether members may create API tokens.

allow_domain_selection.description: Whether members may pick a domain other than the group default.

redirect_mode_policy.description: `direct`, `splash` or `choice`; omitted keeps the current policy.

default_domain_id.description: Id of the group default domain; absent keeps the current value and `null` means the site default. It must reference an active domain.

restrict_domains.description: Whether members are limited to the `domain_ids` allowlist.

domain_ids.description: Domain allowlist; absent keeps the current list, while `null` or `[]` clears it. Entries must reference existing domains.

is_default.description: Whether the group becomes the default group; `true` moves the single default marker.

PublicCreatePayload.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/public/urls`. No credential is required when `public_create_access` is `guest`; a session cookie or Bearer token may be supplied instead, and the link is then owned by that account.

target_url.description: Destination URL. Required; anonymous callers must also match the guest allowlist.

domain.description: Hostname to create the link on; omitted uses the effective default domain.

slug.description: Requested slug; omitted generates one, and a taken slug returns `409`.

tags.description: Tag names to attach; an omitted field means no tags.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry timestamp; it must be in the future.

redirect_mode.description: `direct` or `splash`; omitted takes the default for the account.

captcha_token.description: Bot protection token; only needed for the flows that are protected.

PublicCreatedDto.description: Response of `POST /api/v1/public/urls`. The link id is deliberately not returned: the caller has no account to manage the link with.

domain.description: Hostname of the domain the link was created on.

slug.description: Short code of the new link.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the link was created.

PreviewDto.description: Saved SNS preview metadata of a link, returned by the `/api/v1/urls/{id}/preview` endpoints. An unconfigured preview returns null fields and false flags.

title.description: Custom preview title (at most 200 characters), or `null` when unset.

description.description: Custom preview description (at most 1000 characters), or `null` when unset.

image_url.description: Public image URL served in the preview, or `null` when none is configured or the stored image is suppressed by the current policy.

image_uploaded.description: Whether the stored image came from an upload rather than a URL.

enabled.description: Whether custom preview metadata is served to recognised social crawlers.

Patch.description: Request body of `PATCH /api/v1/urls/{id}/preview`. A field that is absent stays unchanged; `null` or a blank string clears it. Setting or clearing `image_url` replaces or removes any uploaded image.

title.description: New preview title, at most 200 characters; absent keeps it and `null` clears it.

description.description: New preview description, at most 1000 characters; absent keeps it and `null` clears it.

image_url.description: New image URL; it must be absolute HTTPS, at most 2048 characters, without credentials or whitespace. Absent keeps the current image and `null` removes it.

Health.description: Response of `GET /health` (and its `/healthz` alias) used by docker health checks and uptime probes. A failing database answers `503` with `status: degraded`.

UnlockPayload.description: Request body of `POST /{slug}/unlock`, accepted as `application/json` or as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

password.description: Password of the protected link. A wrong value returns `401`.

UnlockResponse.description: JSON response of `POST /{slug}/unlock` on success. A form request is answered with a `303` redirect to `/{slug}` instead.

redirect.description: Same-site path the caller should follow next.

Error.description: Error envelope returned by every `/api/v1/**` failure. The HTTP status and the `code` are chosen together; `message` is always English and safe to show, and internal failures never leak their detail (it goes to the log only).

code.description: Machine-readable error code. `captcha_failed` shares HTTP 400 with `bad_request`; `validation_error` is HTTP 422 and names the offending field in `details.field`.

message.description: Human-readable English message. It never discloses whether an account exists.
message.example: slug may only contain letters, digits, '-' and '_'

details.description: Optional structured detail. Validation failures carry `{ "field": "<name>" }`; other errors omit the key entirely (it is not serialized as `null`).

error.message: slug may only contain letters, digits, '-' and '_'

items.description: Short links on the requested page.
Audit entries on the requested page.

ClickList.description: Paginated click log for one link (`Page<ClickDto>`); no IP addresses or visitor hashes.

items.description: Clicks on the requested page, newest first.
User rows on the requested page.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, or nothing to change. Also returned with `code: captcha_failed` when bot verification fails, expires, or is rejected by the provider (registration, sign-in and session-cookie link creation).

Unauthorized.description: Not authenticated, token revoked, or wrong password.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient permission, CSRF rejection, registration closed, or quota exhausted.

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist, including resources that belong to someone else.

Conflict.description: Uniqueness conflict: email, slug on a domain, or domain hostname.

Gone.description: Short link expired or reached its click limit.

ValidationError.description: Field validation failed; `details.field` names the offending field.

RateLimited.description: Rate limited. The response carries a `Retry-After` header with the number of seconds until the next window boundary.

Retry-After.description: Seconds the caller should wait before retrying.

InternalError.description: Server error. Details go to the log only and are never returned to the caller.

sessionCookie.name: urlet_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session cookie issued by `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (and by registration, which signs the new account in). It slides forward on activity and is cleared by `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`. Cookie-authenticated requests are subject to the CSRF same-origin rule.

bearerToken.description: Personal API token sent as `Authorization: Bearer ur_...`. Tokens are created under `/app/account` or with `POST /api/v1/tokens` and the plaintext value is shown only once. A token is exempt from bot verification on link creation.
